name: WdProtectedViewCloseReason
description: Specifies how the Protected View window was closed.

constants.name: wdProtectedViewCloseEdit
constants.description: The window was closed when the user clicked the Enable Editing or Edit Anyway button while in Protected View.

constants.name: wdProtectedViewCloseForced
constants.description: The window was closed because the application shut it down forcefully or it stopped responding.
